messages.text: Bench check on MX-3360 from Meridian Analog: held regulation at 70C ambient in the sealed enclosure with 8C junction margin. Notes in TR-131. This is a bench check only, not the full TP-PSU-07 qualification.
Sahyadri Electronics quoted MX-3360 at ₹265, MOQ 100, 8 weeks lead time. Quote Q-140 attached to the procurement folder.
